string.name: desc
string.value: Charges energy after every attack. When your energy is fully charged, Accuracy, Attack, DEF, and Movement Speed increase. You also have a chance to activate a Stance that allows you to use energy-type skills. Energy charges twice as fast when attacking bosses.
